corrections.why: The Idaho list says Crowsnest Abandoned and firelookout.com says Abandoned 1930. No source says the crow's nest was removed.
The Idaho list types the site as Crowsnest, and the 1915 newspaper item describes a ladder up a hemlock.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date the crow's nest to 1915. The 1914 association report already mentions a lookout on Green Mountain, while the June 1915 item describes one still to be established. This research keeps 1915 as the register date and notes the 1914 mention.
Forest Lookouts gives section 1 (40N-3E-1), and the 1914 report says Sec. 1. The June 1915 item says 12-40-3 east. The section is unresolved.

notes_for_editor: The 1914 annual report and the June 1915 Elk River Sentinel item are quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; they were not checked against the original paper or report. A search for an independent Green Mountain record in Clearwater County found nothing and returned other Clearwater lookouts instead. The Idaho list's Crowsnest Abandoned status is the basis for the proposed status correction. Today's site condition is not in any source read. Drive-Up is an Idaho Fire Lookouts tag, not a road description.
